contract: At 100 TeV the SUSY-side strange Yukawa times cos(beta) is the central matched-SM calibration. The two pre-threshold d/s ratios are transported from the 1557 examples using a declared relative factor; baseline 1. The 100 TeV light-Yukawa table is an SM reference, so its transport into a split spectrum must be tested. The illustrative positive gluino and mu and the soft Higgs quadratic are additional inputs; 100 TeV and tan(beta)=10 occur in the Babu-Bajc-Saad flavor fit. All dimensionful code quantities are in TeV.
